title: ConvertToChainSecuredAccountRequest
description: Body for `convert_to_chain_secured_account`. The caller is authenticated by their existing API key (header). The supplied wallet becomes the on-chain admin and the account flips from managed to ChainSecured. The conversion is irreversible.

new_admin_wallet_address.description: Hex-encoded EVM address (with or without 0x prefix). Must be the wallet the user controls; verified by an EIP-712 typed-data signature.

typed_data.description: EIP-712 typed-data object the wallet signed. Must use `primaryType: "ConvertAccount"` and the canonical schema (see `core::eip712`).

signature.description: 65-byte 0x-prefixed signature (r||s||v) over the EIP-712 digest of `typed_data`.
